name: Cincinnati Financial
description: Cincinnati Financial sells commercial, personal, excess-and-surplus and life insurance exclusively through independent agencies, plus reinsurance (Cincinnati Re) and Lloyd's specialty business (Cincinnati Global). It earns premiums and invests them, and unusually it keeps a large equity portfolio: in 2025 the investments segment made $2,480M pre-tax, of which $1,442M was investment gains (largely equity-price gains) and $1,165M investment income, against only $501M of property-casualty underwriting profit. So reported net income ($2,393M) depends heavily on the stock market as well as on claims and catastrophes. Personal lines lost money in 2025 (combined ratio 103.6 percent) because catastrophe losses were 22.2 percent of premiums.

employees.note: 5,705 associates: 3,400 at headquarters, 2,195 field associates, 110 at Cincinnati Global.

businessLines.name: Commercial Lines Insurance
businessLines.how: Independent agents sell businesses casualty, property, commercial auto, workers compensation and other cover for annual premiums; Cincinnati earns underwriting profit plus investment income on the float. Premium mix: property $1,655M, casualty $1,638M, auto $1,037M, workers comp $244M, other $424M.

businessLines.name: Personal Lines Insurance
businessLines.how: Independent agents sell personal auto ($1,212M), homeowners ($1,816M) and other personal cover ($402M) on annual renewing premiums; results swing with hurricane and hail catastrophe losses (22.2 percent of premiums in 2025).

businessLines.name: Excess and Surplus Lines Insurance
businessLines.how: Sells cover for risks standard carriers decline (non-admitted market) through wholesale agents at higher, negotiated premiums.

businessLines.name: Life Insurance
businessLines.how: Term ($245M), whole ($54M) and universal life ($61M) premiums, with worksite products sold through employers, plus investment spread on contract holder funds.

businessLines.name: Other: Cincinnati Re and Cincinnati Global
businessLines.how: Cincinnati Re ($591M) sells reinsurance to other insurers; Cincinnati Global ($334M) writes global specialty business through Lloyd's Syndicate 318, a London-based agency.

businessLines.name: Investments
businessLines.how: Interest and dividends on a bond and equity portfolio built from premiums and surplus, plus realised and unrealised gains on equity securities; gains swing with the stock market.

measures.name: Cash-earnings yield
measures.long: Cash earnings (operating cash flow - capex - stock pay) / market value
measures.note: An insurer's operating cash flow includes premiums it holds (float) until claims are paid, so its cash yields run high and swing with how fast it is growing.

measures.name: FCF yield
measures.long: Free cash flow (operating cash flow - capex) / market value
measures.note: An insurer's operating cash flow includes premiums it holds (float) until claims are paid, so its cash yields run high and swing with how fast it is growing.
